title: Mexican Atole with Cinnamon and Brown Sugar
summary: Water, piloncillo and a cinnamon stick are boiled together, then a smooth milk and masa harina slurry is whisked in and simmered for about 5 minutes until creamy.

ingredients.item: piloncillo, chopped, or dark brown sugar
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Boil the water, piloncillo, cinnamon stick and salt until the sugar has dissolved.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Whisk the milk and masa harina until there are no lumps.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Over medium heat, pour in the slurry slowly, whisking constantly, and simmer 5 minutes until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Remove the cinnamon stick and thin with a splash of hot water or milk if needed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into mugs and dust with ground cinnamon.

tips: Whisk the whole time or the masa sinks and catches.
It thickens as it stands; whisk in a little hot milk to loosen.
Grated piloncillo dissolves faster than a whole cone.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 2 days. Reheat gently, whisking in a little milk. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
